name: system.info
description: Returns OS family identifier, version, hostname, screen geometry, and a capability map. Read-only, no side effects. Used by clients to gate verb availability before sending family-specific calls.

windows-modern.description: Reports ui_automation:yes, wgc:yes, integrity_levels:full, image_formats:[png,webp,bmp]. Sourced from RtlGetVersion, GetSystemMetrics, EnumDisplayMonitors.

windows-classic.description: Reports ui_automation:no, wgc:no, integrity_levels:limited, image_formats:[bmp] plus png if a GDI+ runtime is present (runtime-probed at startup). NT 4 reports integrity_levels:none.
